# Octogle Hire

> Senior software engineers embedded in your team, from £1,500/month. The same senior developer UK companies pay around £99,768 a year for, working full time on one client at a time from Octogle's own office, on your standups, in your repo, with your ownership. Three profiles in 48 hours, no placement fee.

## Key pages
- [Octogle Hire](https://try.octoglehire.com): what it is, pricing, how it works, FAQ and booking.

## What it is
- One full-time senior engineer per client. Not a marketplace, not freelancers, not a project handed back on completion.
- Embedded in your team from week one: your product, your repo, your ownership.
- From £1,500/month, with no UK payroll, NI, benefits or overhead on top.
- Three candidate profiles in 48 hours. Swap the engineer if the fit is wrong. No placement fee either way.
